articles.title: 'Das Kadam, Das Ka Dam': Sambit Patra highlights 10 key outcomes of PM Modi's recent foreign visits
articles.summary: BJP MP Sambit Patra highlighted ten key outcomes from Prime Minister Modi's recent visits to Indonesia, Australia, and New Zealand, describing them as strengthening India's strategic, defence, economic and cultural partnerships with Indo-Pacific nations.

articles.title: Deepened bonds, strengthened partnerships: PM Modi concludes three-nation visit, departs from NZ to India
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi concluded his three-nation visit to Indonesia, Australia and New Zealand, elevating India-New Zealand ties to a Strategic Partnership with an ambitious roadmap for cooperation across multiple sectors.

articles.title: "When India's Chandrayaan landed on Moon, all of New Zealand rejoiced": PM Modi hails increasing space sector collaboration
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi hailed increasing collaboration in the space sector between India and New Zealand, noting that New Zealand's technology contributed to the success of India's Chandrayaan moon landing mission.

articles.title: 'Bond with India remains unwavering': PM Modi after meeting diaspora in New Zealand
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi met with members of the Indian diaspora in New Zealand and expressed deep gratitude for their overwhelming enthusiasm, noting they had awaited an Indian Prime Minister's visit for four decades.

articles.title: PM Modi hails outcomes from Indonesia visit as "comprehensive, substantive and futuristic"
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi welcomed the outcomes from his discussions with Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto, affirming that India-Indonesia bilateral relations will continue to scale new heights with 20 Memorandums of Understanding signed.
